Game Overview

In Funny Rescue Sumo, the core idea is straightforward: step into the role of nurse and stylist for a sumo wrestler in Funny Rescue Sumo. Tend to battle wounds with care, then unleash your creativity with an array of fashionable choices. Easy mouse controls make it perfect for all ages, offering a delightful blend of caregiving and fashion fun.
